tasks.redPrompt:
Write failing tests for #221 — anonymous visit to / must redirect to the sign-in page instead of rendering the 'Signed out / Sign in' stub; an EXPIRED token found at boot gets the session-expired login variant.

WORKING DIRECTORY: /home/ai-teams/workspace-app
REPO GUARD: cd /home/ai-teams/workspace-app && git remote get-url origin — abort unless it ends in mvox-app.git.

Read: gh issue view 221 --comments (the LAST comment is Gama's expired-session refinement). Research findings with verified anchors: teams/mvox-dev/memory/research/research-221.json.

VERIFIED FACTS (research 2026-09-03 on main 0ea592c; re-check line drift):
- src/lib/auth/guard.ts:37 `const PUBLIC_EXACT = new Set(['/', '/about'])` (issue cited :38 — off by one). isProtectedPath (:41-46) early-returns false for /auth/*, /invite/*, /_app/*, /.well-known, asset-extension paths BEFORE consulting PUBLIC_EXACT, then falls through to `return true`. resolveGuardRedirect (:54-64) checks only isTokenValid(token, nowMs) (boolean, :31-35, uses decodeJwtExpMs) and on failure always returns the PLAIN `/auth/login?redirect=<encodeURIComponent(pathname+search)>` — it does NOT distinguish no-token from expired-token today.
- src/routes/+layout.ts:15-28 wires the guard SYNCHRONOUSLY in load(): getToken() (storage.ts helper) → resolveGuardRedirect → redirect(302, target). It never consults hydrateAuth or authStore — Gama's sketched plumbing (hydrateAuth flag / second store value) targets the wrong module; the WHOLE fix lives in guard.ts. hydrateAuth (session.ts:25-50) publishes identical {status:'anonymous'} for both no-token and expired branches; DO NOT touch session.ts.
- src/lib/auth/session-expired.ts:29 `sessionExpiredSignInHref(pathname: string, search = ''): string` builds `/auth/login?error=session_expired&redirect=<target>`. The module has ZERO imports — safe to import from guard.ts, no cycle.
- src/lib/auth/guard.spec.ts pins current behavior in three places: :56 loop asserts isProtectedPath('/') is false; :80-84 asserts resolveGuardRedirect({pathname:'/', token:null}) returns null; :91-102 asserts the expired-token case returns the SAME plain string as no-token. All three must move.
- The anonymous stub at src/routes/+page.svelte:6998-7003 has NO spec coverage anywhere (verified — no spec references auth-status testid, agenda_signed_out, or agenda_sign_in). No Playwright/E2E infra exists in this repo. Do not hunt for either.
- Login round-trip already works: safeRedirectTarget (src/lib/auth/redirect.ts:4-7) passes '/' through; callback goto(outcome.redirectTo) returns the user to /. No test changes needed there.

CONTRACT TO PIN (frozen):
(a) isProtectedPath('/') === true; isProtectedPath('/about') === false; /auth/* and /invite/* remain unprotected.
(b) resolveGuardRedirect for pathname '/' with NO token → exactly '/auth/login?redirect=%2F'.
(c) resolveGuardRedirect for pathname '/' with an EXPIRED token → exactly the sessionExpiredSignInHref('/', '') string (i.e. '/auth/login?error=session_expired&redirect=%2F' — assert the full literal, derive it once from sessionExpiredSignInHref in the spec to avoid drift).
(d) resolveGuardRedirect for a VALID token on '/' → null (allowed).
(e) Query survives: pathname '/' + search '?collective=polyphony' with no token → redirect value encodes the full '/?collective=polyphony'.
(f) '/about' with no token → null (still public).

TESTS (all in src/lib/auth/guard.spec.ts):
1. :56 public-paths loop: remove '/' from the array; add '/' to the protected-routes assertions (isProtectedPath('/') === true).
2. :80-84 'returns null for a public path': retarget pathname to '/about' (keeps the public-null contract pinned); ADD a new test asserting contract (b) with a full-string toEqual.
3. :91-102 expired-token test: INVERT — expired must now produce the session-expired URL (contract c), and a sibling test pins that no-token and expired produce DIFFERENT strings.
4. New tests for contracts (d), (e), (f) where not already pinned.
Full-string assertions (toEqual on the exact URL), never toContain — partial assertions have shipped real bugs on this team.

Run the targeted spec to confirm the new/inverted tests FAIL for the right reason (current code returns plain redirect / null). pnpm check must stay at 0 errors (no stubs needed — guard.ts already compiles). Stage EXPLICITLY by path.

tasks.commitBody:
An anonymous visit to / now redirects straight to /auth/login instead
of rendering the agenda's 'Signed out / Sign in' stub. '/' leaves the
guard's PUBLIC_EXACT allowlist, so the existing synchronous layout
guard 302s before the page can mount — no intermediate render, no
flash. The login page's redirect handling returns the user to / after
sign-in (round-trip verified through the OAuth callback).

Gama's expired-session refinement is included, in the guard rather
than the sketched hydrateAuth plumbing (the cold-visit path never
consults authStore): resolveGuardRedirect now classifies the stored
token as none / expired / valid and sends the expired case to the
session-expired login variant (error=session_expired) so the user
sees why they were signed out. Display/routing-only — no token write
path touched.

The unreachable anonymous stub and its two i18n keys
(agenda_signed_out, agenda_sign_in) are deleted from +page.svelte and
all four locales. +layout.svelte's completion-gate condition drops
its now-redundant `path === '/'` special case and its stale comment.

Known notes: a token expiring between the guard pass and hydrateAuth
now yields a blank agenda instead of the old stub (narrow pre-existing
race, changed failure mode only); robots.txt still says 'Allow: /',
which now 302s for crawlers — flag to PO if root-path indexing is
ever wanted.

Live gate (Mihkel, phone per §8.2): signed out, open mvox.eu cold →
sign-in page directly at /auth/login?redirect=%2F, no 'Signed out'
text; sign in → agenda; log out, reopen / → sign-in again, Back does
not trap; with an expired token stored, cold / shows the
session-expired notice on the login page.
